d:
U.S. President Donald Trump is open to providing Ukraine with NATO-style, Article 5-like security guarantees as part of a potential peace deal with Russia, U.S. special envoy Jared Kushner said on Thursday.
Speaking after talks in Berlin with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and European leaders, Kushner said significant progress had been made on security guarantees and a post-war economic recovery plan for Ukraine.
